tha-ap163:1.1: Bandhujīvakavaggo soḷasamo. [161. Supāricariya.] Padumo nāma nāmena dipadindo narāsabho / pavanā abhinikkamma dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā // //
tha-ap163:2.1: Yakkhānaṃ samayo āsi avidūre mahesino / yena kiccena sampattā ajjhāpekkhiṃsu tāvade // //
tha-ap163:3.1: Buddhassa giram aññāya amatassa ca desanaṃ / pasannacitto sumano appoṭhetvā upaṭṭh' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap163:4.1: Suciṇṇassa phalam passa upaṭṭhānassa satthuno / tiṃsakappasahassesu duggatiṃ n' upapajj' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap163:5.1: Ūnatiṃse kappasate Samalaṅkata-nāmako / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap163:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Supāricariyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Supāricariyattherassa
